patch_notes: 7.2-7.3 Absolution; 6.3 soul auto-absorb + AA not interrupted by abilities
mapper: G-Touch (Android). Fallback: V-Touch or Mantis Gamepad Pro MOBA Smart Cast. iOS unsupported.
problem: Default AA treats Absolution souls as valid units and steals Relic Cannon wind-up.

verdict.option_1: Wins the stated combat bug: hold champion portrait, never AA wards/souls/minions, fire only when a champ portrait appears (in range).
verdict.option_2: Wins max-range kite and skill aim: AA/skill Skill Wheel on RS, Aim Panning moves the map with aim. Recenter on AA release is not native; map L3 to camera lock.

hybrid_layout.RS: camera pan when idle; Skill Wheel when Y/B/X/RT held
hybrid_layout.RB: TAP default AA (souls / last-hit after fight)
hybrid_layout.L3: TAP camera recenter (stand-in for release-AA recenter)

G_Touch_extras.RT_Y_B_X: Skill Wheel Mode linked to right stick
G_Touch_extras.cast_cancel: map cancel zone to D-pad down or unused face chord

practice_tool: Hold RT near souls: must not AA souls
Dummy enters AA range: portrait appears, RT hits dummy only
Dummy leaves range while holding RT: Senna does not walk (Follow OFF)
Hold B + RS: W wheel and camera pan with aim
Release B then L3: camera recenters
Hold RT + LS: move and fire without stopping
Tap RB: can AA remaining souls
Q while portrait-locked: beam hits champ, not soul at feet
